blind.description: A stylized vintage iron street lamp post. It features a flared hexagonal base resting directly on the ground, a vertical tapered post with decorative molding rings, a horizontal ladder-rest crossbar beneath the light fixture, a six-sided lantern casing with warm cream-yellow glass panels, and a pointed hexagonal cap topped with a spherical finial. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled without floating or melted elements. Materials are dark patinated bronze/iron with lighter edge highlights and glowing/painted glass panes.
blind.from_above: A hexagonal faceted lantern roof with radiating structural ribs meeting at a central round finial ball.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 to 1.4 times the height of the figure (roughly 7.5 to 8 feet tall), and quite narrow at roughly 1.5 to 2 feet wide at the base.
